heroes.name: Rama
heroes.description: A measured archer who keeps a clear firing lane and steps away from pressure. Strong aimed shots reward patient positioning.
heroes.silhouette: Tall curved bow, swept sash, narrow crest

abilities.name: Steady Arrow
abilities.description: Fire a powerful aimed projectile. Cover blocks the shot.

abilities.name: Measured Step
abilities.description: Dash forward up to 10 metres. Walls stop the movement.

abilities.name: Dawn Volley
abilities.description: Brace in place for 1 second, then release three arrows along the locked firing angle. Each arrow can hit separately; cover blocks them.

heroes.name: Ravana
heroes.description: A deliberate frontline controller. Gather enemies around a chosen point, then close the distance before releasing a nearby blast.
heroes.silhouette: Ten-faceted crown, broad mantle, ring blade

abilities.name: Tenfold Guard
abilities.description: Grant a temporary shield to yourself and nearby allies.

abilities.name: Commanding Circle
abilities.description: Damage enemies in the aimed circle and pull them toward its centre. Solid cover limits displacement.

abilities.name: Crownfire
abilities.description: Blast enemies around you in a broad circle.

heroes.name: Arjuna
heroes.description: A quick archer who changes angles between volleys. High mobility comes with the roster’s smallest health reserve.
heroes.silhouette: Long bow, split shoulder scarf, high quiver

abilities.name: Converging Volley
abilities.description: Strike enemies in a forward fan within 18 metres.

abilities.name: New Angle
abilities.description: Dash forward up to 12 metres to change your firing position.

abilities.name: One Clear Line
abilities.description: Fire a fast, heavy projectile along your aim.

heroes.name: Duryodhana
heroes.description: A durable close-pressure fighter. Hold a position with a small allied shield, then punish enemies who remain in front of you.
heroes.silhouette: Square shoulder guards, low crown, heavy mace

abilities.name: Mace Shock
abilities.description: Strike enemies in the short area in front of you.

abilities.name: Hold the Ground
abilities.description: Shield yourself and close allies for a brief defensive stand.

abilities.name: Iron Crescent
abilities.description: Sweep a heavy wave through enemies in a broad forward cone.

heroes.name: Hanuman
heroes.description: A mobile ally who leaps between skirmishes and restores nearby teammates. His final pulse rewards reaching a crowded frontline.
heroes.silhouette: Curved tail, flowing scarf, rounded mace

abilities.name: Windward Leap
abilities.description: Leap forward up to 14 metres. Solid obstacles stop your advance.

abilities.name: Bring Them Home
abilities.description: Restore health to yourself and allies close to you.

abilities.name: Mountain Pulse
abilities.description: Brace for 0.7 seconds, then leap to the aimed ground point. On landing, damage nearby enemies and heal nearby allies. Cover limits travel.

heroes.name: Karna
heroes.description: A slower marksman with heavy basic shots. A brief guard lets him hold an angle; his close-range final burst answers an enemy rush.
heroes.silhouette: Radiant shoulder discs, crescent bow, long sash

abilities.name: Sunshaft
abilities.description: Fire a fast aimed projectile through a clear firing lane.

abilities.name: Borrowed Dawn
abilities.description: Give yourself and nearby allies a short-lived shield.

abilities.name: Solar Reprisal
abilities.description: Strike enemies immediately around you with a bright area blast.

heroes.name: Bhima
heroes.description: A forceful close-range fighter who commits to a lane. Leap into reach, pressure the forward arc and save the broad blast for a contested objective.
heroes.silhouette: Broad torso, crossed straps, long-headed mace

abilities.name: Heavy Sweep
abilities.description: Strike enemies in a close forward cone.

abilities.name: Closing Stride
abilities.description: Leap forward up to 12 metres. Walls stop the advance.

abilities.name: Thunder at Your Feet
abilities.description: Damage enemies in a wide circle around you.

heroes.name: Meghnad
heroes.origin: Ramayana · Indrajit/Meghnad traditions; original arena kit
heroes.description: A swift disruptor who places slowing pressure before changing angle. Catch a lane in the cloud zone, then turn a flank into a forward burst.
heroes.silhouette: Forked crest, compact bow, layered cloud scarf

abilities.name: Cloud Snare
abilities.description: Place an aimed zone that damages and slows enemies who remain inside.

abilities.name: Storm Step
abilities.description: Dash forward up to 13 metres, stopping at solid cover.

abilities.name: Gathered Squall
abilities.description: Strike enemies in a long forward fan.

heroes.name: Sita
heroes.description: A resilient protector. Restore nearby allies, shape the approach with a slowing zone and shield a gathered team.
heroes.silhouette: Leaf-tipped staff, long mantle, seed-shaped crest

abilities.name: Grove Renewal
abilities.description: Restore health to yourself and allies within the nearby circle.

abilities.name: Rooted Path
abilities.description: Place an aimed zone that damages and slows enemies crossing it.

abilities.name: Shelter of Mithila
abilities.description: Prepare in place for 0.8 seconds, then raise a fixed sanctuary for 6 seconds. Nearby allies gain a shield; allies who remain inside steadily recover health.

heroes.name: Draupadi
heroes.description: A resolute guardian. Shield allies, gather approaching enemies into a clear target area and restore a team holding its ground.
heroes.silhouette: Five-point mantle clasp, flame staff, upright crown

abilities.name: Circle of Resolve
abilities.description: Give yourself and close allies a temporary shield.

abilities.name: Stand Accountable
abilities.description: Damage enemies in the aimed circle and pull them toward its centre; solid cover limits movement.

abilities.name: Unbroken Assembly
abilities.description: Restore a large amount of health to yourself and allies in a broad nearby circle.

heroes.name: Subhadra
heroes.description: A mobile field commander. An aimed opening shot and a small recovery circle support teammates; temporary allied sentinels reinforce a contested lane.
heroes.silhouette: Spear pennant, rounded shoulder guards, side braid

abilities.name: Signal Lance
abilities.description: Fire an aimed energy projectile toward the opposing line.

abilities.name: Rally Close
abilities.description: Restore health to yourself and allies close to your position.

abilities.name: Twin Standards
abilities.description: Call two temporary allied sentinels beside you for 9 seconds.

heroes.name: Hidimbi
heroes.description: A guardian with a strong presence around objectives. Control an approach, protect close allies and reinforce the lane with temporary sentinels.
heroes.silhouette: Broad leaf mantle, braided crest, forked spear

abilities.name: Forest Boundary
abilities.description: Place a nearby aimed zone that damages and slows enemies inside it.

abilities.name: Canopy Guard
abilities.description: Shield yourself and allies standing close to you.

abilities.name: Grove Watch
abilities.description: Call two temporary allied sentinels beside you for 9 seconds.

heroes.name: Chitrangada
heroes.description: An agile defender who crosses a firing lane, answers with a spear arc and protects nearby allies. Her speed trades away the heavier vanguards’ health.
heroes.silhouette: Short segmented mantle, braided knot, crescent spear

abilities.name: Crossing Step
abilities.description: Dash forward up to 12 metres to cross or leave a firing lane. Solid obstacles stop movement.

abilities.name: Spear Arc
abilities.description: Strike enemies in a close forward cone with a sweeping energy blade.

abilities.name: Defender’s Vow
abilities.description: Grant a strong temporary shield to yourself and nearby allies. Gather close before committing to the fight.

heroes.name: Ulupi
heroes.description: A guardian who gathers opponents into a clear target area and restores nearby allies. Her broad slowing zone controls an approach while leaving other routes open.
heroes.silhouette: Wave crest, scale-edged collar, water-ring staff

abilities.name: River Draw
abilities.description: Damage enemies in the aimed circle and draw them toward its centre. Solid cover limits displacement.

abilities.name: Cooling Current
abilities.description: Restore health to yourself and allies standing nearby.

abilities.name: Naga Basin
abilities.description: Place a broad aimed zone that damages and slows enemies remaining inside for up to 6 seconds.
